messages:
Sana: Heads-up: Noah T (contractor, APAC) just confirmed project wrap. Proposed last day 2026-05-07. He flagged visa sponsorship wrap and company phone SIM return. Can we triage items?
Renee: Confirmed last day 5/7. Need handoff on two active tickets and ownership of the partner integration. I'll list PRs and tag new owner.
Luis (Payroll): For contractors we process final invoice. Ask Noah to submit final invoice by 5/5 to hit 5/12 payout. No COBRA eligibility for contractors, FYI.
Sana: Good — I'll send invoice reminder and confirm contractor pay classification. Also checking whether any reimbursable hardware was granted.
Gus (IT): Inventory shows: company phone (iPhone, S/N ZXY987), YubiKey MFA, and a MacBook Pro S/N MBO-555. Need return shipping address and preferred return date. We'll plan to revoke VPN + AWS console access on 2026-05-08 02:00 UTC.
Emily (Logistics): I can arrange a local courier pickup in APAC. Please confirm whether we should provide a prepaid label or courier will pick network fuel-up item. Also confirm SIM must be sanitized or destroyed?
Anya (Security): Security note: please rotate any OAuth client secrets Noah has access to. Also request to remove his service account ACLs for the analytics prod bucket. We prefer access removal after final artifact handoff.
legal-bot: legal-bot: If any NDA/custodian data is present, Legal requests 180-day email retention hold by default for contractors involved in partner integrations. Please confirm if this applies.
Sana: @legal-bot noted. Renee — was Noah on any data export or signed SOWs that should trigger retention?
Renee: He had partner creds and pulled logs for debugging last month. I think Legal want the hold. Please keep email/Drive until Legal confirms release.
Gus (IT): Example revoke script we'll run (ops-only):
```
# revoke OAuth client & service account access
./infractl revoke --user noah.t --oauth --service-accounts analytics-prod --when 2026-05-08T02:00Z
```
We'll hold off on disabling email/Drive until People Ops/Legal confirm retention.
Luis (Payroll): Also check 401k/benefits — contractor is not enrolled. No deferral. Confirming final invoice timeline is critical for payroll window.
Sana: On invoice and shipping. I'll send Noah the final checklist today: invoice by 5/5, return label pickup slot 5/6-5/9 (he picks), confirm SIM destruction preference, and sign-off on access handoff doc.
Emily (Logistics): Booking tentative pickup window 2026-05-06 09:00-12:00 local. Will send courier details after Noah confirms pickup address.
Anya (Security): Please also ensure YubiKey is returned — if not, we'll deprovision and document serial.
Renee: I'll collect PR list and share ownership. Also will ask Noah to complete the quick knowledge capture doc by 5/4.
Sana: Thanks — summarizing actions: People Ops email + invoice reminder today; Legal retention hold requested; IT will queue deprovision for 2026-05-08 02:00 UTC but hold email/Drive; Logistics to arrange APAC pickup; Payroll awaiting invoice. If anything urgent, DM me. :white_check_mark:
